Anthropic reviews every application; must comply with supportability policies
on_screen_only: Page header: '1 year of Claude Team | $1K in Claude API credits | Up to $45K in offers from partners'
Hero text: 'Start up and stand out'

FAQ 'What do members get?': 'One year of Claude Team free for up to five Premium seats if you're new to Team, $1,000 in Claude API credits if you're new to the Claude Console, up to $45K in offers through the Claude Startup Stack, office hours with Anthropic's Applied AI team, and access to Claude Startup events like Founder House, hackathons, and meetups.'

FAQ 'Who can apply?': 'Startups founded in the last 5 years or funded in the last 2. You'll need a Claude Console account, a company email that matches your website's domain, and a short description of what you're building. We review every application. Applicants must comply with Anthropic's supportability policies.'
cta: Go to the site, apply, follow for more

relevance.why: Directly applicable: a solo founder with a company <5 years old and a domain email can get a free year of Claude Team (5 seats), $1K API credits for app AI features, and partner discounts (Linear, Granola, Gamma). High-value, low-effort.
